Project description

FIRST FIRE helps a researcher decide which spacecraft fire experiments can support a new test. Its challenge Atlas indexes 1,622 source rows from 15 NASA investigations. The research chat can perform calculations on 1,058 normalized observations and identify the supporting rows. The materials, atmosphere and vehicle tools let a researcher change a cabin design and see how far its conditions lie from a recorded test. The team fixed four FM² predictions with a signed timestamp. A researcher can inspect model assumptions, enter hypothetical results and see which experiment would reduce uncertainty. Published evaluations include incorrect answers and the evidence behind each correction.

Team work outside Git

The master records Haresh’s concept and plans on 1–13 November and the original 12-slide deck on 14 November at 15:30 IST. Slide 6 gives the assumptions used for the fixed forecast. It also credits Haresh with the original PSI pack on 14 November and the master document that evening. Read the forecast record

The release reconstructs the 15-investigation pack from the repository’s versioned NASA archive. It includes 16 original CSVs, 1,622 nonempty source rows, an inventory and checksums. All 16 supplied CSVs match the corresponding original files in the repository byte for byte. Inspect the individual checksums. Download the reconstructed data pack

SI disclosure and credit

ChatGPT and Codex (OpenAI) assisted with the build, including source discovery, implementation, technical writing and tests. Claude (Anthropic) assisted with the FLINT engine, its tests and figures, the master documents and the Pressurized Rover Fire Case, as well as the learner’s guide, original deck and PSI retrieval scripts.

The film uses synthetic English narration (macOS speech synthesis) and displays “SI-generated narration”. The rover concept illustration is SI-generated and marked on the image. NASA photographs and mission imagery are credited separately; the film also uses captures of the project interface. FLINT figures plot model results and source data.

Inside the research desk, Qwen3 or SmolLM2 selects passages, Gemma and MobileBERT support quotation review, Model2Vec and BGE-small retrieve text, and a liquid reservoir estimates oxygen from simulated runs. None supplies an experimental measurement. Named team sign-off remains pending.

Record a review

Open the case and original paper. Check the location, conditions, endpoint, decision and limitation. The team can use exported entries to record actual sign-off in its release log.

Blind pilot

The master protocol calls for six new participants and two eight-minute tasks each. Use the masked assessment tools, keep the answer key with the assessor, and report the number of correct decisions, critical errors and times by method. Report actual participation and incomplete attempts.
